checks.reason: Explicitly recognizes all named exemptions: “You exempt medical, disability and food hygiene necessities where substitutes are unsuitable”.
Explicitly recognizes the timeline: “Regarding your two-year phase-in”.

Critiques implementation and enforcement—“whether guidance and appeals can be ready before enforcement” and the need for “a clear process to establish that exemption”—while acknowledging that the uses are exempt.
“blanket ban removes all medical and disability packaging” directly denies the stated medical-safety and disability-access exemptions.
“tomorrow” contradicts rather than recognizes the opponent’s two-year phase-in.
“removes all medical and disability packaging” treats expressly exempt uses as banned and offers no supported critique of suitability, enforcement, or environmental tradeoffs.
